releaseScope: Current working-tree source only; published 0.1.4 packages have not been rebuilt or reassessed by this record.

findings.developmentImpact: Parsing an attacker-controlled indexed source map with an excessive section offset can block the Node event loop. The affected version was reachable in the installed build/development dependency tree.
findings.desktopRuntimeAssessment: The shipped UI is a Vite browser bundle. PostCSS runs at build time; Blockly's browser mapping excludes jsdom. Source inspection indicates these dependency paths are outside the desktop browser runtime; this is not an exploit test or a claim about every published binary.
findings.resolution: Upgrade the existing transitive lock entry within its declared semver range; no override or new direct dependency.

findings.developmentImpact: The installed Node dependency is affected. The high advisories concern WebSocket handshake denial of service and BalancedPool dropping function-valued TLS options; exploitability requires using those APIs with the described inputs. No application-specific exploit was run. Other lower-severity advisories are preserved in the before audit receipt.
findings.desktopRuntimeAssessment: ProcedureWorkbench imports blockly/core, blockly/blocks and locale modules. Blockly 13.2.1 selects its browser entry for this Vite build and maps jsdom to false. Do not infer runtime exposure or safety solely from npm's prod/dev/peer flags; the Node peer remains installed and is upgraded.
findings.resolution: Upgrade the existing transitive lock entry to 7.30.0, above the 7.29.1 fix, within jsdom's ^7.25.0 range.

findings.patchedFrom: 3.1.8 (all advisories in the captured audit; authority injection fixed in 3.1.7)
findings.developmentImpact: URI host/port normalization defects affect code that uses attacker-controlled URI components for request routing. ui-core uses Ajv for local schema/fixture checks; validate.mjs registers local files without a remote loadSchema callback. The dependency is still updated rather than suppressed.
findings.desktopRuntimeAssessment: Development-only dependency of ui-core. ui-shell does not depend on Ajv or fast-uri; the local schema checker is not shipped as a Node runtime service.
findings.resolution: Upgrade the existing lock entry within Ajv ^3.0.1 to 3.1.8; no new direct dependency or override.

verification.limits: npm advisory snapshot only; excludes Java libraries, bundled JDK, OS components and published package bytes.
